2609.11725.title: Continuous-Time Acoustic Modelling with Neural Controlled Differential Equations
2609.11725.paper_summary: Text-to-speech (TTS) models commonly address text--speech alignment by expanding phone-level encoder states to frame-level decoder inputs using predicted durations. While this length-regulation step resolves alignment structurally, this use of duration typically changes only where and how often latent states appear, not the values of the states themselves. This paper proposes a continuous-time mechanism for duration-aware acoustic modelling in TTS using neural controlled differential equations (CDEs). We formulate the phone representation as a temporally parameterised control path and use a neural acoustic vector field to produce a continuous-time hidden state whose values evolve with phonetic content and duration-derived timing. The resulting trajectory can be sampled at discrete points and integrated into a standard acoustic decoder pipeline. Objective results contrast CDEs and typical recurrent models. Subjective results suggest that CDE-based models evaluating one phone per step can improve rank-order agreement between synthesised and reference emotion intensity while maintaining comparable emotion-expression quality to a strong baseline. Additional experiments with half-phone step-sizes suggest that temporal resolution changes the trade-off between style tracking and absolute calibration. These results position CDEs as a promising design space for continuous-time and duration-aware style-sensitive TTS.
2609.11725.paper_summary_zh: 文本到語音（TTS）模型通常通過使用預測的持續時間將音素級編碼器狀態擴展到幀級解碼器輸入來解決文本與語音的對齊問題。雖然這個長度調整步驟在結構上解決了對齊問題，但這種持續時間的使用通常僅改變潛在狀態出現的位置和頻率，而不是狀態本身的值。本文提出了一種基於神經控制微分方程（CDEs）的持續時間感知聲學建模的連續時間機制。我們將音素表示形式構建為時間參數化的控制路徑，並使用神經聲學向量場生成一個隨著語音內容和持續時間衍生的時序變化的連續時間隱藏狀態。生成的軌跡可以在離散點進行取樣，並整合到標準聲學解碼器管道中。客觀結果對比了CDEs和典型的遞歸模型。主觀結果表明，基於CDE的模型在每一步評估一個音素時，可以提高合成情感強度與參考情感強度之間的排名一致性，同時保持與強基線相當的情感表達質量。對半音素步長的額外實驗表明，時間解析度改變了風格追蹤和絕對校準之間的權衡。這些結果將CDEs定位為連續時間和持續時間感知風格敏感TTS的一個有前景的設計空間。
